name: run_python
description: Run a Python script inside a bubblewrap sandbox to inspect the target binary. The sandbox exposes the target ONLY at /workspace/binary (read-only); /scratch is writable for intermediate dumps (e.g. objdump output); the network is isolated; python3 standard library and binutils (file, readelf, objdump, nm, strings, xxd, od, hexdump, size, c++filt) are available, but NO third-party packages (no capstone/pyelftools -- parse ELF via subprocess to readelf/objdump or struct). Each call returns an observation_id and evidence_id(s) you must cite in the final verdict.

script.description: Full Python source. Call binutils via subprocess, e.g. subprocess.run(['objdump','-d','-Mintel','/workspace/binary'],capture_output=True,text=True). Return findings on stdout (that becomes your evidence).

timeout_sec.description: Execution timeout in seconds. 0 means default 240.

max_output_chars.description: Cap captured stdout/stderr characters (head+tail). 0 means default 60000.

name: run_semantic_probe
description: After run_python has localized a PatchSpec behavior, evaluate bounded OLD and NEW instruction discriminators in one executable address window. The Host runs a fixed sandboxed objdump script; this tool never executes model-authored code. It returns old_only, new_only, both, or neither plus a citable semantic_probe evidence id.

behavior_id.description: A behavior_id from the supplied PatchSpec behavior support contract.

localization_evidence_ids.description: One or more existing positive evidence ids that localized this exact code window.

start_address.description: Inclusive virtual address at which bounded disassembly begins.

stop_address.description: Exclusive virtual address at which bounded disassembly stops.

focus_regex.description: Safe regex that must match the focal instruction/call in the window.

max_instruction_gap.description: Maximum intervening instructions between ordered required regexes.

name: submit_detection_result
description: Submit behavior-scoped supports, a claim covering every support and required behavior, and a status assertion. The Host derives and validates the canonical verdict plus legacy evidence fields from supports + claim.
